references.text: Jesus heals a man who was mute because of a demon, demonstrating his power over demons, similar to the situation in Matthew 17:16 where the disciples could not heal the boy.
Jesus gives the disciples authority to drive out unclean spirits and heal every disease and weakness, making their inability in Matthew 17:16 especially remarkable.
A similar event where a man brings his demon-possessed son to Jesus' disciples, but they cannot cast out the demon, paralleling the situation in Matthew 17:16.
Jesus' teaching about faith as small as a mustard seed, which immediately follows a similar healing story, offers insight into why the disciples could not heal the boy in Matthew 17:16.
Abraham's faith and God's response illustrate the power of faith, which can be connected to the disciples' lack of faith in Matthew 17:16.
David's song of praise about God's healing power can be viewed in light of Jesus' healing ministry and the disciples' inability to heal in Matthew 17:16.
